#!/bin/sh
# Flux batch script converted from PBS

# NOTE:
#   PBS requests 2 Polaris nodes and then dynamically sizes MPI ranks to the
#   number of GPUs detected per node.
#   Flux batch directives must be static, so we request 2 nodes and a total of
#   8 ranks assuming 4 GPUs/node on Polaris.
#
# Run with: flux batch <this_script>

# PBS resources:
#   -l select=2:system=polaris
#   -l place=scatter
#   -l walltime=8:00:00
#   -l filesystems=home:eagle
#   -q preemptable
#   -A datascience
#   -N GNN_DDP_4

#flux: --job-name=GNN_DDP_4
#flux: -N 2
#flux: -n 8
#flux: -c 1
#flux: --time-limit=8h

# Omitted PBS option: -l place=scatter
# Flux placement policies are site/config dependent; no portable equivalent.
# Performance implication: ranks may be placed differently across nodes/NUMA domains, potentially impacting performance.

# Omitted PBS option: -q preemptable (queue)
# Flux queues/partitions are site-specific; no portable equivalent.
# Performance implication: job may not be preemptable (or may have different priority/limits), affecting scheduling and preemption behavior.

# Omitted PBS option: -A datascience (account)
# Flux accounting/project selection is site-specific; no portable equivalent.
# Performance implication: job may be charged to a default account or be rejected by policy.

# Omitted PBS option: -l filesystems=home:eagle
# Flux filesystem selection attributes are site-specific; no portable equivalent.
# Performance implication: required filesystems may not be available, causing I/O failures or degraded performance.

# PBS variable $PBS_O_WORKDIR is not set under Flux.
cd "${FLUX_JOB_SUBMIT_DIR:-$PWD}"

TSTAMP=$(date "+%Y-%m-%d-%H%M%S")
echo "Job started at: {$TSTAMP}"

source /lus/eagle/projects/datascience/sbarwey/codes/ml/pytorch_geometric/module_config

# PBS used mpiexec with hostfile/ppn; under Flux, use flux-run.
# Omitted mpiexec options: --hostfile/--ppn/--cpu-bind none
# Performance implication: without explicit binding/ppn control, rank placement and affinity may be suboptimal.

flux run -n 8 -c 1 ./set_affinity_gpu_polaris.sh \
  python3 main.py seed=65 use_noise=True topk_rf=4

reasons: PBS requested GPUs implicitly by scaling ranks to the GPU count and by targeting Polaris (`select=2:system=polaris`), but the Flux resource section does not request any GPU resources; on GPU-managed systems this may allocate CPU-only resources and the job may fail or run much slower.

PBS specified a queue (`-q preemptable`) and account (`-A datascience`) but the Flux resource section has no queue/account selection; on sites where these affect eligibility/limits, scheduling behavior may differ or the job may be rejected.

inputs.script:
#!/bin/sh
#PBS -l select=2:system=polaris
#PBS -l place=scatter
#PBS -l walltime=8:00:00
##PBS -l walltime=1:00:00
#PBS -l filesystems=home:eagle
#PBS -q preemptable
##PBS -q debug
#PBS -A datascience
#PBS -N GNN_DDP_4


# Change to working directory
cd ${PBS_O_WORKDIR}

TSTAMP=$(date "+%Y-%m-%d-%H%M%S")
echo "Job started at: {$TSTAMP}"


# Load modules: 
source /lus/eagle/projects/datascience/sbarwey/codes/ml/pytorch_geometric/module_config

# Get number of ranks 
NUM_NODES=$(wc -l < "${PBS_NODEFILE}")

# Get number of GPUs per node
NGPUS_PER_NODE=$(nvidia-smi -L | wc -l)

# Get total number of GPUs 
NGPUS="$((${NUM_NODES}*${NGPUS_PER_NODE}))"

# Print 
echo $NUM_NODES $NGPUS_PER_NODE $NGPUS

# run 
mpiexec \
	--verbose \
	--envall \
	-n $NGPUS \
	--ppn $NGPUS_PER_NODE \
	--hostfile="${PBS_NODEFILE}" \
    --cpu-bind none \
	./set_affinity_gpu_polaris.sh python3 main.py seed=65 use_noise=True topk_rf=4
